background.$description: The page, and the fill of inputs and outline buttons. Not for a surface that floats above the page: use popover.

foreground.$description: Body text and icons on background, muted or popover. Not on a colored fill: use its own -foreground token.

muted.$description: A quiet fill set apart from the page: hover rows, code, kbd, secondary badges. Not for text: use muted-foreground.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text: hints, placeholders, captions, inactive tabs. Not for text the user must read to act.

border.$description: Hairlines that separate or outline: inputs, cards, tables, panels. Not for focus: use ring.

popover.$description: The fill of what floats above the page: popovers, menus, tooltips, toasts, dialogs. Not for the page itself.

sidebar.$description: The fill of an application's side navigation, a step off the page. Not for panels inside the content: use muted.

primary.$description: The one main action and the selected state: primary button, checked switch, active segment, links. Not for status: use danger, success, warning or info.

primary-foreground.$description: White or black text on the primary, whichever reads on it. Only on a primary fill.

ring.$description: The focus outline drawn on :focus-visible. Not for borders or selection.

accent.$description: The application's second color, for the hover of icon buttons. Not for the main action: use primary.

halo.$description: The disc behind an icon button on hover. Not as a background for content.

glow.$description: The bright heart of a light, at the center of the mascot. Not for text, fills or surfaces: use background or popover.

overlay.$description: The veil behind a modal dialog or sheet. Not for anything that stays interactive.

danger.$description: Actions that delete or cannot be undone, and errors: the danger button, the error state, the danger toast and alert. Not to draw attention to a safe action.

danger-foreground.$description: Text and icons on a danger fill. Only on danger.

success.$description: A completed or valid outcome, as in a success toast. Not for a neutral confirmation the user did not wait for.

warning.$description: Something the user should check before going on, as in a warning toast. Not for errors: use danger.

info.$description: Neutral information, as in an info toast. Not for links or actions: use primary.

highlight.$description: Matched search terms, behind .lu-mark. Not for selection or status.
